name: Fluc
notes: Old-school per-ISO-week calendar pages (YYYY_Flucwoche##.html), one for Fluc and one for Fluc Wanne room per day; no per-event URLs or prices published, so price_min/price_text/category/description stay null and url points at the week page. Real event content only extends ~6-7 weeks out (through late Sept 2026 as of build); weeks beyond that are pre-generated but empty placeholders, so record count tapers to 0 well before EA_HORIZON_DAYS is reached - normal, not a bug.
